snippet.title: Skyward Masters - Official Closed Alpha Teaser
snippet.description:
⭐ Wishlist Skyward Masters on Steam ⭐
▶ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224920/Skyward_Masters/

🎮 Skyward Masters is a strategic arena FPS developed by indie studio Trinor Entertainment, inspired by the Bedwars base defense formula.

4️⃣ Four teams clash on floating islands in fast-paced, action-packed battles, combining co-op teamplay, arena shooter combat, base defense and Bed Wars inspired strategy. 🟦🟧🟪🟩

⚔ Fight fast, adapt fast, and outlast your opponents in biomes that change between battles to be the last team standing.

🏆 Joining the development, CS legend dupreeh brings years of competitive FPS experience to help shape the game.

Join Discord HERE: https://discord.gg/skywardmasters
